heading: side
name: 文字卡＋直向圖片跑馬燈卡並排
desc: 左右兩張等高卡片並排：左卡上方放標題組、下方放兩欄連結按鈕；右卡是一欄橫式圖片持續往上流動的直向跑馬燈。手機改為上下堆疊，跑馬燈改為橫向流動。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。標題組放在左側一欄，其餘內容在右側一欄：左右兩欄各是一張卡片，各佔約一半寬、等高，兩張合起來幾乎橫跨整個畫面寬，左右只留窄邊。左側卡片內，上方靠左放標題組，標題組包含標題（可多行），標題約佔卡片寬一半，上方可放小標籤，沒有時省略；卡片下半部靠左放一組按鈕，每顆按鈕左側是文字、右側是箭頭小圖示，排成兩欄，按鈕組約佔卡片寬六成；標題組和按鈕組分居卡片上下兩端，中間留大片空白。右側卡片內是直向跑馬燈：多張橫式、同一比例的圖片排成一欄，在卡片內水平置中、約佔卡片寬七成，持續往上流動並循環；圖片欄貼齊卡片的上下緣，最上與最下的圖片被卡片上下緣裁切。
mobile: 改為直向堆疊：文字卡片在上、圖片卡片在下，各自橫跨畫面寬、左右留窄邊。文字卡片內標題組在上，按鈕改為單欄、每顆按鈕橫跨卡片內容寬，緊接在標題組下方，不再分居上下兩端。圖片卡片的跑馬燈改為橫向一列，圖片仍為橫式，持續往左流動並循環；圖片列貼齊卡片的左右緣，左右兩端的圖片被卡片邊緣裁切，圖片列在卡片內垂直置中。

en.name: Text card + vertical image marquee card side by side
en.desc: Two equal-height cards side by side: the left card holds the heading group at the top and two columns of link buttons at the bottom; the right card is a vertical marquee of landscape images flowing continuously upward. On mobile they stack, and the marquee flows horizontally.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. Place the heading group in a side column, with the rest of the content in the other column: each of the left and right columns is a card, each about half the width and equal in height, and together the two cards span almost the full screen width with only a narrow margin on the left and right. Inside the left card, place the heading group at the top, aligned left; the heading group contains a title (may wrap to multiple lines), about half the card width, optionally with a label above; omit it when there is no content. In the lower half of the card, aligned left, place a group of buttons, each with text on the left and a small arrow icon on the right, arranged in two columns, the group taking about sixty percent of the card width; the heading group and the button group sit at opposite ends of the card, top and bottom, with generous empty space between them. Inside the right card is a vertical marquee: multiple landscape images of the same aspect ratio arranged in a single column, horizontally centered in the card and about seventy percent of the card width, flowing continuously upward and looping; the image column is flush with the top and bottom edges of the card, and the topmost and bottommost images are cropped by those edges.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout.
en.mobile: Stack vertically: the text card on top and the image card below, each spanning the screen width with a narrow margin on the left and right. In the text card the heading group stays at the top, and the buttons become a single column, each button spanning the card's content width, placed directly below the heading group instead of at opposite ends of the card. The marquee in the image card becomes a single horizontal row; the images remain landscape and flow continuously to the left, looping; the image row is flush with the left and right edges of the card, the images at both ends are cropped by the card edges, and the row is vertically centered in the card.
